one_line: Tang-dynasty pilgrim Xuanzang studying under the aged abbot Śīlabhadra at Nalanda, c. 637–643 CE.

appearance.age_look: Xuanzang appears as a lean man in his early thirties, Śīlabhadra as a slight, dignified elder of over one hundred years, both with upright but calm bearing.
appearance.face: Xuanzang has an oval face, light olive East Asian complexion, straight brows, large focused anime-style eyes, a straight nose and calm, determined expression; Śīlabhadra has a narrow, softly wrinkled face, medium brown Magadhan complexion, fine lines at the eyes, gentle smile and serene, wise gaze.
appearance.hair: Xuanzang’s head is clean-shaven under a plain light-ochre cloth hood that extends from his outer robe; Śīlabhadra’s head is also clean-shaven, uncovered, with a thin fringe of short white hair just above the ears and at the nape.
appearance.costume: Xuanzang wears a layered Tang-era pilgrim monk outfit: a long-sleeved, ankle-length inner robe in muted warm beige, belted simply at the waist, over which drapes a voluminous kashaya-style outer robe in soft light ochre with subtle darker ochre patchwork rectangles; over his left shoulder hangs a travel cloak in slightly weathered gray-brown wool, with a folded edge indicated at his chest; simple dark brown cloth shoes peek from under the robe hem; Śīlabhadra wears a classic Nalanda monk’s ensemble: an ankle-length saffron-yellow under-robe with long, narrow sleeves, tied with a thin ochre sash, and an upper red-brown kashaya robe wrapped over the left shoulder and under the right arm in broad, straight folds, the fabric shown as matte cotton; his feet are in simple dark brown leather sandals, and his right shoulder and upper arm are modestly covered by the robe’s fall rather than left bare.
appearance.signature: Xuanzang carries a tall slender wooden staff with a rounded top ring holding several small metal rings and suspends at his side a cylindrical dark-brown leather scroll case filled with rolled Sanskrit manuscripts, while Śīlabhadra holds a palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin cord in his left hand.

ref_desc: Xuanzang is a clean-shaven, light-ochre-robed Tang monk with gray-brown travel cloak, staff and dark-brown scroll case, beside Śīlabhadra, a frail clean-shaven Nalanda elder in saffron under-robe and red-brown kashaya, holding a palm-leaf manuscript, all in warm beige, ochre and dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet showing Xuanzang and Śīlabhadra standing side by side: Xuanzang as a lean early-thirties Tang Buddhist monk with an oval light-olive face, large focused eyes and a calm determined expression, his head clean-shaven under a simple light-ochre cloth hood flowing from his outer robe. He wears a long-sleeved, ankle-length inner robe in muted warm beige, belted at the waist, covered by a voluminous light-ochre kashaya robe with subtle darker ochre patchwork rectangles, plus a gray-brown wool travel cloak draped over his shoulders, and simple dark brown cloth shoes; he holds a tall slender wooden staff with a ringed top and has a dark-brown cylindrical leather scroll case filled with rolled manuscripts at his side. Beside him, show Śīlabhadra as a slight, dignified elder with a narrow medium-brown face, fine wrinkles, gentle smile and serene wise gaze, his head clean-shaven with a thin fringe of short white hair above the ears. He wears an ankle-length saffron-yellow under-robe with long narrow sleeves and an ochre sash, covered by a red-brown kashaya robe wrapped over his left shoulder in broad folds that modestly cover the torso and upper arm, and dark brown leather sandals. Use a warm palette of saffron yellow, light ochre, red-brown, warm beige and dark brown, and pose them in calm, scholarly stances that clearly show their faces, hairstyles, layered robes, footwear, staff, scroll case and palm-leaf manuscript from head to toe.
